text:
nina: Quick thread: Rita asked for a safe EU rollout path that preserves latency and gives them an opt-in A/B cohort. Need to scope today.
todd: What's "safe" mean here? hard SLOs, cost cap, or both?
rita-cust: Hi all  we need latency <=200ms p50/p95, automatic fallback to smaller model on perf regressions, and an experiment where 5% of EU traffic is in the A arm for 14 days. No global KMS changes.
marcus: Ops: we'll need per-tenant+region flag, a canary ramp plan, and a circuit-breaker that triggers on sustained p95 breach or error surge. Recommend 3-stage ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 72h.
ux-liz: UX: enterprise customers require visible cohort labels, an opt-out toggle, and a short explanation of what fallback means in plain language. I'll draft microcopy.
todd: Implementation notes: router already tags region. We'll add flag: tenant:rita region:eu -> experiment config + fallback rule. Config example: FLAG={"name":"rita.eu_soft_fallback","cohorts":[1,5,20],"trigger":{"p95_ms":220,"err_pct":1.5},"fallback_model":"r Redwood-small"}
marcus: +cooldown 10m, min-fallback 15m, and a daily cap on fallback activations. Also emit event: fallback.engagement with reason.
ops-bot: infra check: quota ok for small model pool; temp dashboard created under /dashboards/rita-eu-rollout.
nina: Launch criteria proposal: 1) staging run with synthetic prompt set shows <0.5% semantic regressions for 12h, 2) production canary stable at 5% for 24h with no SLO violations, 3) rollback tested end-to-end in staging.
todd: Measurement: define key prompt set for semantic checks and 3 automated eval signals (bleu-ish, length-normalized similarity, custom heuristics). Who owns that?
rita-cust: We'll provide 150 "golden" prompts and expected outputs. Can our PMs get access to telemetry?
nina: Yes, we'll surface telemetry in the tenant console for Rita: p50/p95, fallback-count, experiment cohort metrics, semantic-regression-rate.
ux-liz: UI work: console toggle, cohort opt-in, notification banner during canary. ETA: 3 design-days.
marcus: SRE runbook: explicit kill-switch (global) + tenant-squelch command. Example curl: curl -X POST $ADMIN/switch -d '{"tenant":"rita","region":"eu","mode":"force-fallback"}' 
ops-bot: reminder: tag all PRs w/ sprint ticket and include runbook link.
rita-cust: Timeline: can we start canary in 2.5 weeks? Security and legal cleared.
todd: Dev estimate: 5 dev-days to add flag + router hook + tests, 2 days for QA, 1 day for infra config. If prioritized we can make 2.5 weeks.
nina: Risks: billing surprise if fallback increases tokens, semantic drift invisible to simple metrics, thrash from flappy triggers. Mitigations: cost cap alert, richer evals, cooldown and max-activations/day.
marcus: Also add a shadow mode first: route mirrored traffic to fallback model without serving it, to compare outputs. That reduces risk before full canary.
ux-liz: I'll prototype the console copy and opt-out flow tomorrow.
todd: Action items: Todd open feature flag PR + tests; Marcus draft runbook + shadow pipeline; Nina write launch-criteria doc and coordinate tenant comms; Rita to confirm golden prompts and stakeholder list.
rita-cust: Confirmed, will share prompts and announce to EU product owners. Thanks! :thumbsup:
